sample_unit: clinical documents (case reports and physician-written progress notes)

links.outcome: F1 performance gap from in-domain case reports to out-of-domain progress notes
links.effect: Performance dropped out-of-domain for both models; LLM F1 gap ID-OOD = -8.6, MLM baseline gap = -13.9.
links.quote: The LLM demonstrated greater robustness, with a smaller performance gap in F1-scores (ID-OOD = -8.6) compared to the MLM baseline performance (ID-OOD = -13.9).

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning LLMs for Japanese clinical NLP and choosing LLMs over masked language models for robustness to document-type shift

screen.reason: Evaluates the robustness of fine-tuned Japanese LLMs on out-of-domain clinical notes (disease name recognition benchmark) without evaluating a specific operational guardrail or organizational deployment practice.
